periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the eye patches is oriented diagonally; the patch on the left (viewer perspective) is angled roughly 45 degrees towards the upper-left, while the right patch is more vertically aligned.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: High aspect ratio characterized by elongated oval blobs where the vertical height significantly exceeds the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: There is a distinct downward tapering in both patches, with the lower portions narrowing significantly below the geometric center.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are positioned on the upper lateral quadrants of the head with a wide gap approximately equal to the width of the forehead.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The ear tops exhibit a rounded, semicircular curvature with minor jaggedness due to individual fur tufts.

other_distinctive_markers: The ventral fur and paws exhibit significant brownish-yellow soil staining, contrasting with the high-reflectance white fur on the cranium.
